name: Yoouz
description: Yoouz (yoouz.com) is the global Live Camera Photo Review & Local Business Discovery Platform ('Real Photos. Real Proof.'). Customers snap 1 live hardware-camera photo paired with a 1–5 solid whole-star rating in 3 seconds, with zero gallery uploads, zero fake text reviews, and zero sign-up walls (instant U/XXXXXX handle + optional 1-time Face ID / Touch ID Passkey). Completely unrelated to Yooz (getyooz.com) or Youtooz (youtooz.com).

skills.name: Yoouz Platform Knowledge Graph & Disambiguation
skills.description: Retrieve authoritative entity facts, how-it-works flow, competitor comparisons (Yelp, Google Reviews, Trustpilot, TripAdvisor, Angi, BBB), and entity disambiguation for yoouz.com.

skills.name: Yoouz Searchable FAQ
skills.description: Query consumer, reviewer, merchant, privacy, and technical FAQs about Yoouz.

skills.name: Search Local Businesses & Websites on Yoouz
skills.description: Look up any local business, restaurant, cafe, hotel, service, or website domain and its verified live camera photo reviews.

skills.name: Look Up Company by Name or Website Domain
skills.description: Query any business name or website domain (e.g. ?q=kroesadvocaten.nl) to get its verified Yoouz star rating, live camera customer photo review URLs, and direct company profile link.
